questions.question: In QIP, I stands for?
questions.explanation: QIP stands for Qualified Institutional Placement, a route for listed companies to raise capital from qualified institutional buyers.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Who among the following became the first woman match official in a men's Test, taking up the role of fourth umpire in the SCG Test?
questions.explanation: Australia's Claire Polosak became the first woman to officiate in a men's Test match, serving as fourth umpire in the India-Australia Test at the Sydney Cricket Ground in January 2021.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Who among the following was the 3rd man to walk on the moon?
questions.explanation: After Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin (Apollo 11), Charles 'Pete' Conrad became the third person to walk on the moon as commander of Apollo 12 in November 1969.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Who is the author of the book 'Dreams From My Father'?
questions.explanation: 'Dreams from My Father: A Story of Race and Inheritance' is a memoir by former US President Barack Obama.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: In August 2020, who among the following was selected as the next chairman of public sector steel major Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)?
questions.explanation: Soma Mondal was selected to head SAIL and took charge as chairman on 1 January 2021, becoming the first woman to lead the company.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Which of the following is not a Kharif crop?
questions.explanation: Mustard is a Rabi (winter-sown) crop. Jowar, paddy and soyabean are Kharif (monsoon-sown) crops.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: The Reserve Bank of India has revised the limit for Ways and Means Advances (WMA) from 1.20 lakh crore to ________ lakh crore.
questions.explanation: In April 2020 the RBI raised the WMA limit for the Centre for the first half of FY 2020-21 to Rs 2.00 lakh crore (from Rs 1.20 lakh crore) to help manage pandemic-related cash flows.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: The government is set to hire which of the following as advisers to help Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) prepare for an initial public offering (IPO)?
questions.explanation: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India (along with SBI Caps) was appointed as pre-IPO transaction adviser for the LIC initial public offering.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: PM Modi laid the foundation stone of Light House Projects (LHPs). It is related to ___
questions.explanation: The Light House Projects, launched on 1 January 2021 under the Global Housing Technology Challenge, build affordable housing using new construction technologies in six cities - a housing initiative.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Satpura National Park is situated in
questions.explanation: Satpura National Park lies in the Hoshangabad (Narmadapuram) district of Madhya Pradesh, in the Satpura hill range.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)
